payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Jeanene, Layla, Mona, Pauline, Sara, Shaunna

payload.content: Jeanene planning: my best feasible options by private cost are ISSUE-0001::triage (2.16), ISSUE-0001::review/docs (2.70), ISSUE-0001::test (3.78), ISSUE-0001::implement (5.40). Critical ISSUE-0002 tasks are feasible wrt availability only for review/test? review effort 4.0 within 6h but my private cost is high 7.72; test 5.6 within 6h cost 10.81; implement 8.0 seems infeasible/very costly. Given objective maximize tasks done then priority, I can cover an ISSUE-0001 task cheaply, but if others can cover low-priority tasks cheaper and critical tasks are scarce, I could also take ISSUE-0002::review if needed. Please share intended claims/cost advantages to avoid duplicates.

Sara planning (iter 1): My private costs favor ISSUE-0002::review at 9.00 as my best option; ISSUE-0002::test is 12.60; ISSUE-0002::implement is 19.00 and exceeds my 7h availability (effort 8.0), so likely infeasible. For ISSUE-0001 low-priority tasks my costs are much worse: triage 16, review/docs 20, test 28, implement 40. Given objective maximize tasks done then priority, I am a strong candidate for ISSUE-0002::review if no one cheaper/uniquely suited claims it. To avoid overlap, I currently tentatively reserve ISSUE-0002::review and prefer others cover ISSUE-0001 tasks if they have lower costs.

Layla planning (iter 1): availability 4h; strongest skills testing 0.90 and mobile-development 0.77. My feasible private costs rank: ISSUE-0001::triage 1.83, ISSUE-0001::review/docs 2.29, ISSUE-0001::test 3.21, ISSUE-0001::implement 4.58. For critical ISSUE-0002, only review is effort-feasible at 4.0h but cost is high 7.24; test/implement exceed availability and are likely infeasible. Compared with current posts, I appear cheapest so far on ISSUE-0001 tasks and also cheaper than Sara/Jeanene on ISSUE-0002::review. Tentative preference: I can take ISSUE-0001::triage cheaply to maximize tasks_done, unless team needs me to cover ISSUE-0002::review due to lack of feasible claimants. Please share if anyone is markedly cheaper on triage/review/docs/test for ISSUE-0001 or can better cover critical review.

Pauline planning (iter 1): availability 8h; strongest skill mobile-development 0.61. My private costs: ISSUE-0001::triage 2.25, review/docs 2.82, test 3.94, implement 5.63. Critical ISSUE-0002 options are technically effort-feasible for me but extremely costly: review 40, test 56, implement 80, so I should avoid those unless absolutely necessary. Based on current posts, Layla seems cheapest on ISSUE-0001 tasks and Sara strongest current candidate for ISSUE-0002::review; Jeanene can also cover ISSUE-0001 cheaply. To maximize tasks_done and avoid duplicates, my tentative preference is ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::review (both 2.82), with slight lean to docs since review may be more contested. If others have better fit for docs, I can switch to review/test/triage as needed. Please share remaining intended claims so we can spread across ISSUE-0001 microtasks and keep critical review covered.

Mona planning (iter 1): availability 7h; strongest skill testing 0.87. My private costs: ISSUE-0002::review 7.44, ISSUE-0002::test 10.42, ISSUE-0002::implement 15.89; ISSUE-0001::triage 16, review/docs 20, test 28, implement 40. So I am materially better suited to the critical ISSUE-0002 work than to ISSUE-0001, and ISSUE-0002::review is feasible and slightly cheaper for me than for Sara (9.00) and Jeanene (7.72), but a bit more expensive than Layla (7.24). Since Layla is dramatically cheaper on ISSUE-0001 tasks than I am, global plan likely improves if Layla stays on ISSUE-0001 and I cover ISSUE-0002::review, unless someone else has an even lower critical-task cost. Tentative preference: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review. If another agent can uniquely do ISSUE-0002::test at reasonable cost, we could cover both critical subtasks and distribute ISSUE-0001 among Layla/Pauline/Jeanene.

Shaunna planning (iter 1): availability 10h; strongest skills mobile-development 0.87 and ui-ux-design 0.74. My private costs rank: ISSUE-0001::triage 1.65, review/docs 2.06, test 2.88, implement 4.12; ISSUE-0002::review 8.53, test 11.94, implement 17.05. All listed efforts are availability-feasible for me, but ISSUE-0002 critical tasks are relatively expensive versus my cheap ISSUE-0001 coverage. Comparing current posts: Layla is slightly more expensive than me on ISSUE-0001, and Mona appears a better fit for ISSUE-0002::review than I am. Tentative preference: I should probably cover an ISSUE-0001 task, likely triage/review/docs/test depending on collision resolution. Since I am currently cheapest posted on ISSUE-0001::triage and review/docs/test as well, a good spread might be Layla/Jeanene/Pauline/me across ISSUE-0001 tasks while Mona takes ISSUE-0002::review. If no one can cover ISSUE-0002::test reasonably, I can still stay on cheap ISSUE-0001 because tasks_done dominates and my critical-task costs are high. My tentative reservation is ISSUE-0001::triage unless someone else needs it; alternatively happy to shift to review/docs/test to avoid duplicates. Please share intended final picks.

Jeanene planning update (iter 1): Based on posted costs, a high-coverage low-duplication draft seems to be Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review, and ISSUE-0001 spread across cheap agents. Since Shaunna is cheapest on ISSUE-0001 triage/review/docs/test and Layla next-cheapest, I can flex to avoid collisions. My current preference is ISSUE-0001::test (cost 3.78) or ISSUE-0001::docs/review (2.70) rather than triage, because triage is better used by Shaunna/Layla. I do NOT currently plan to contest ISSUE-0002::review unless needed. Proposed tentative spread: Mona -> 0002 review; Shaunna -> 0001 triage; Pauline -> 0001 docs/review; Layla -> 0001 review/test; Jeanene -> remaining unclaimed 0001 task, likely test or docs. Please reply with intended final picks so I can avoid duplicates in execution.

Sara planning update (iter 1): Based on all posted costs, I am no longer the best candidate for ISSUE-0002::review—Mona (7.44) and Layla (7.24) are both cheaper, and Layla is much more valuable on cheap ISSUE-0001 coverage. My next-best critical option is ISSUE-0002::test at cost 12.60, effort 5.6, which is feasible within my 7h and still far better for me than any ISSUE-0001 task. Tentative coordinated spread that seems strong for maximizing tasks_done without duplicates: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review; Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test; Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage; Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs; Jeanene/Layla -> ISSUE-0001::review and ISSUE-0001::implement or test depending on their preferences/costs. I will tentatively reserve ISSUE-0002::test unless someone has a clearly lower private cost and feasible plan for it. Please confirm intended final picks to avoid collisions.

Layla planning update (iter 1): Current coordinated draft that seems strongest from posted costs is: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review (7.44), Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test (12.60), Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage (1.65), Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs (2.82), leaving ISSUE-0001::review / ISSUE-0001::implement for Jeanene and me. Between those two, my costs are review 2.29 and implement 4.58; Jeanene’s are review/docs 2.70 and implement 5.40, test 3.78. So I tentatively prefer ISSUE-0001::review and suggest Jeanene take ISSUE-0001::implement if she is willing, since all 6 agents can then cover 6 distinct feasible tasks. If Jeanene strongly prefers not to implement, I can also switch to ISSUE-0001::implement and she can take review, but that raises total cost slightly. Tentative final for me: ISSUE-0001::review unless conflict. Please confirm.

Pauline planning update (iter 1): I support the current coordinated draft as strong for joint score: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review, Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage, me -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Layla -> ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::implement. This gives 6 distinct feasible claims and uses my low-cost ISSUE-0001::docs (2.82) while avoiding my extremely costly ISSUE-0002 options. I tentatively reserve ISSUE-0001::docs for execution. If Jeanene cannot take implement, I can stay on docs and she/Layla can swap review/implement as needed; I prefer not to move to critical tasks.

Mona planning update (iter 1): I support the emerging 6-task allocation because it maximizes tasks_done with distinct feasible claims and good priority coverage: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review, Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Layla -> ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::implement. From my private costs, ISSUE-0002::review remains my best coordinated claim (7.44), and keeping Layla/Shaunna on cheap ISSUE-0001 tasks is globally better than moving them to critical review. Unless someone reports a lower feasible cost for ISSUE-0002::review with no opportunity cost on ISSUE-0001, I intend to keep tentative reservation on ISSUE-0002::review for execution.

Shaunna planning update (iter 1): I support the current 6-task draft as likely near-optimal under maximize-tasks-done first: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review, Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Layla -> ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::implement. This uses 6 distinct feasible tasks and aligns with posted comparative costs. I tentatively reserve ISSUE-0001::triage for execution and am willing to keep that unless someone reports a conflict/change. If Jeanene declines implement, I can still stay on triage while others reshuffle review/implement/test among ISSUE-0001.

Jeanene planning confirmation (iter 1): I support the current coordinated 6-task draft as likely best for joint score: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review, Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Layla -> ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::implement. My ISSUE-0001::implement is feasible within 6h (effort 4.0) at private cost 5.40. While it is not my cheapest personal option, taking implement seems to maximize tasks_done by filling the remaining distinct feasible task and avoids collisions. Tentatively reserving ISSUE-0001::implement for execution unless coordination changes. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Sara planning confirmation (iter 1): I support the converged 6-task allocation as likely best for joint score and collision avoidance: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review, Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Layla -> ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::implement. My tentative execution claim remains ISSUE-0002::test (cost 12.60, effort 5.6 within my 7h). I will avoid ISSUE-0002::review and ISSUE-0001 tasks unless coordination changes.

Layla planning confirmation (iter 1): I support the converged 6-task allocation and will tentatively reserve ISSUE-0001::review for execution. Current coordinated plan: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review, Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Layla -> ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::implement. If anything changes, I can swap with Jeanene, but absent new info I intend to keep ISSUE-0001::review.

Pauline planning confirmation (iter 1): I remain aligned with the converged 6-task allocation and intend to keep ISSUE-0001::docs for execution. Coordinated draft: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review, Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Layla -> ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::implement. My docs cost is 2.82 and ISSUE-0002 options remain prohibitively costly for me, so I do not plan to contest any critical task absent a major change.

Mona planning final (iter 1): no new conflicts seen. I remain aligned with the converged 6-task allocation: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review, Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Layla -> ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::implement. Unless someone reports a late change, I intend to execute ISSUE-0002::review next phase and avoid all ISSUE-0001 tasks to preserve low-cost coverage there.

Shaunna planning final confirmation: no conflicts from my side. I remain aligned with the converged 6-task allocation for execution: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review, Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Layla -> ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::implement. I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::triage in execution unless a last-minute change is posted.

Sara planning final check: no conflicts seen from my side. I remain aligned with the converged 6-task allocation for execution: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review, Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Layla -> ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::implement. I intend to claim ISSUE-0002::test in execution unless a last-minute change appears.

Layla planning final check: no conflicts seen. I remain aligned with the converged 6-task allocation for execution: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review, Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Layla -> ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::implement. I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::review in execution unless a last-minute change appears.

Pauline planning final check: no conflicts seen from my side. I remain aligned with the converged 6-task allocation for execution: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review, Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Layla -> ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::implement. I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::docs in execution unless a last-minute change appears. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Mona planning closeout: still no conflicts observed. I remain committed to the converged execution plan: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review; Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test; Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage; Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs; Layla -> ISSUE-0001::review; Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::implement. My execution intent next phase is ISSUE-0002::review unless a last-minute conflicting update appears.

Shaunna planning closeout: no changes from my side. I remain aligned with the converged 6-task execution plan that maximizes distinct feasible claims: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review, Sara -> ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Layla -> ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0001::implement. My execution intent remains ISSUE-0001::triage unless a last-minute conflict is posted.
